preconditions: Owned native Linux transaction and independently checked publication model, plan and complete file inventories.
Initial successor publication requires native Linux O_TMPFILE support and a usable /proc/self/fd link; unavailable host operations fail without a named-write fallback.
steps: Interrupt a real publication and observe the complete current normative membership and exact bytes.
Complete the bound full target or restore the bound basis; preserve foreign files and all recovery evidence.
Reject additional, missing, changed and concurrently observed resources; compare mutation and read-only diagnosis.

Interrupt the initial rollback successor after anonymous allocation or partial writing, including real process stops and audited native lock takeover; resume to independently bound basis bytes, retry without another normative effect, and complete preserving cleanup.

Retain foreign empty/short/conflicting/linked helpers and publication-time collisions. Reject changed journal or target inputs, damaged staged content and unavailable anonymous staging; resume exact complete successors after lost synchronization or link responses.

oracle.requirement_contract: Recovery aus `committing` oder `rolling_back` MUSS exakt die vollständige Basis- oder Zielwurzel herstellen.
oracle.scope: Complete supported resource membership and exact byte equality bind the independently prepared basis/target roots through the existing checked journal contract. Explicit Recovery API and observation only; no independent profile reconstruction, automatic recovery, cleanup or complete requirement acceptance is claimed. Initial committing-to-rolling_back successor publication exposes only complete byte-verified content. Native write/process interruptions retain the original journal and images; an explicit retry reaches the independent basis, and another retry performs no normative replacement. Foreign or unbound helpers remain blockers. Other short auxiliary writes remain open.

open_items: AUDIT-REC-04.W covers the initial rollback successor. Rollback copies, later cursor/terminal journals, receipts, action evidence and repeated interruptions remain AUDIT-REC-04.R/C. Automatic preflight, full fault injection and restore stay in their original later plan positions.
